item.title: Elias Mansor on goal and call-up
item.description: Elias Mansor scored in Millwall Under 21s' 2-0 Professional Development League win over Watford on Friday afternoon. After originally being credited with the first goal, replays showed the final touch came off a Hornets defender - sorry, Elias! - but the midfielder did net in the second-half to ensure three points for Kevin Nugent's side. Below, hear from the Afghanistan international after the full-time whistle and his call-up to the national team once again.

item.title: Under 18s beat Wigan at Calmont Road
item.description: Millwall's Under 18s defeated Wigan Athletic 3-1 in the Professional Development League on Saturday. The Latics took the lead on 10 minutes as the ball was bundled over the line following a corner-kick, but 10 minutes into the second-half, Chris Perry's side were level as substitute Regan Anderson's run into the penalty area and strike resulted in a goal. item.title: Ten-woman Lionesses defeated at Aylesford
item.description: Millwall Lionesses were beaten 4-1 at Aylesford on Sunday. Gabby Buddle-Smith gave Ted Jones' side the lead in just the seventh minute at the Aylesford Recreation Ground, but the hosts equalised in the 37th minute to ensure the sides went in level at the half-time break. item.title: Mayor returns as Massey makes debut
item.description: Alfie Massey made his Southend United debut from the bench last weekend. The Shrimpers were beaten 1-0 at Altrincham in the Enterprise National League, however, as the midfielder was brought into the play in the 78th minute as a substitute for James Morton. Elsewhere, Adam Mayor's welcome return from injury continued as he played the final 22 minutes of Cambridge United's 1-0 Sky Bet League Two success over Salford City.
